piles.note: The piles of bulky things beside the store (feature visible-work, ticket 02). Each thing has four sizes of picture (assets/piles/<art>_1 ... _4, 1 = smallest). steps = the stored amount from which size 1, 2, 3, 4 shows (below the first: no pile). dx, dy = where the pile's feet stand, from the store's standing point, in farm pixels; w = the width of the biggest size, scales = the width of each size as a share of w.
